title: spawnery
description: Helm validates values.yaml and every --set against this before rendering. It exists because without it a wrong value was rejected by the operator's flag parser instead: the container exited at startup with `invalid value "30" for flag -startup-deadline`, which reaches a cluster as CrashLoopBackOff and names neither the value nor the key. What is validated here is what has actually gone wrong, plus types; the pass-through values (resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity, additionalLabels) are deliberately left open, because a schema that is wrong about them fails an install that would have worked.

digest.description: Empty, or an algorithm-prefixed digest. A bare hex string is the shape somebody reaches for first and it is not what a container reference takes.

image.description: One of tag or digest has to name something. With both empty the templates render an image reference ending in a colon, and helm's own error is a YAML parse failure pointing at deployment.yaml rather than at the value that is missing.

interval.description: A Prometheus duration, which is not a Go one: no fractions and no compound units.

startupDeadline.description: A Go duration, so it carries a unit: 5m, 20s, 1h30m. A bare number is accepted by YAML and refused by the flag parser at container start, which is the failure this whole file exists for.

leaderElect.description: A bool, not a YAML string. `yes` is a string here, and the flag parser refuses it at container start.

allowPluginVolumes.description: A bool, for the reason leaderElect is one. Lets a group mount a PersistentVolumeClaim, through spec.extraPlugins (docs/plugins.md) or a spec.mounts entry that names one (docs/mounts.md). Not a security control -- a PersistentVolumeClaim is in the same trust domain as the group naming it.

networkNamespaces.description: Namespaces holding a Network, and the forwarding secret in each. Renders a Role and RoleBinding per entry, narrowed with resourceNames to exactly those secrets. Empty means none are rendered and config/rbac/forwarding-secret-reader.yaml is applied by hand instead.

namespace.description: The namespace that holds the Network.

secrets.description: The Secret names each Network in that namespace points its forwardingSecretRef at. Required and non-empty: an entry with none would render a Role granting get on every Secret in the namespace, which is what naming them exists to avoid.
